memorii.detalii:
De la: The CodeRabbit Team <hello@coderabbit.ai>

Thread: 1a20899799917587
Data: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 13:30:03 +0000
Subiect: Meet CodeRabbit Verify: agentic app testing for QA teams.

Conținut:
CodeRabbit

 

Hi bogdanstancu1119-maker,

We just launched
CodeRabbit Verify ( https://www.coderabbit.ai/verify )
to help your QA teams with agentic application testing.
As coding agents produce more code, manual testing of
code changes can become a release bottleneck.

CodeRabbit Verify addresses that bottleneck,
and it’s now in public beta.
CodeRabbit already reviews your code. CodeRabbit Verify
now automatically tests your running application to
check that it meets your QA team’s functional
expectations.

You can use CodeRabbit Verify to:

* Test the changes in a PR.
  Automatically generate test scenarios from the
  commits in a PR and codebase context, then run
  them against your app.
* Catch regressions across your application.
  Generate journeys for user facing workflows and
  run them on demand or on a schedule.
* Find test failures and fix them, for free.
  Watch tests run in a live browser, inspect recordings,
  screenshots and logs, then send the findings to
  CodeRabbit Agent for a free fix.

CodeRabbit also prepares the test infrastructure
and gets your application running in an isolated sandbox.

To try it,
open CodeRabbit Verify ( https://app.coderabbit.ai/verify )
and configure your repository using the
setup documentation ( https://docs.coderabbit.ai/verify/setup ).
Then, comment
@coderabbitai verify
on your next PR and we’ll run the tests for you.

PR tests, user journey runs and fixes with
CodeRabbit Agent are free during public beta.

Try CodeRabbit Verify → ( https://app.coderabbit.ai/verify )

We’d love to hear what you find.
Reply if you’d like help getting started.

Thanks,

CodeRabbit

Available on CodeRabbit Cloud for GitHub Cloud,
GitLab.com and Bitbucket Cloud.

CodeRabbit

ID Gmail: 1a2093f8fc6b7e33
Thread: 1a2093f8fc6b7e33
Data: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 16:31:29 +0000
Subiect: Free plan returns for Hacksgiving

Conținut:
Hi folks,

No time to mince words with a witty intro.

A lot of exciting stuff is going live this week, and it's Hacksgiving (which is our best attempt at naming our November hackathon). It will come as no surprise that the details… are below.

The Return of the Free Plan

Yes, we have a Free Plan ( https://fly.io/changelog/introducing-the-free-plan/?utm_campaign=November+Launches&utm_content=November+Launches&utm_medium=email_action&utm_source=customer.io ) again. You get $5 of usage every month, on the house. It's made for personal orgs, and you will need to add a card to sign up. The Free plan includes:

* Up to 3 Machines and 3 Sprites, so there's room for an app, a worker and somewhere for your agent to cook.
* Volumes up to 5 GB, to store things in.
* One member (you) and community support.

For the full details and the obligatory T's and C's look here ( https://fly.io/pricing/?utm_campaign=November+Launches&utm_content=November+Launches&utm_medium=email_action&utm_source=customer.io ).

MPG for Four Bucks

You wanted a cuter MPG plan and we delivered. Developer ( https://fly.io/changelog/highly-available-managed-postgres-for-4-a-month/?utm_campaign=November+Launches&utm_content=November+Launches&utm_medium=email_action&utm_source=customer.io ) is the smallest Managed Postgres plan we've ever made. You get a shared CPU, 256 MB of RAM and 1 GB of storage for a meager $4 a month. It doesn't get point-in-time restore or read replicas, so it's better for development and side projects than the project paying your rent.

Your Agent Has More Agency

Your agent can now do more boring things all by itself:

* Sign up for a Fly.io account. We now support auth.md ( https://fly.io/auth.md?utm_campaign=November+Launches&utm_content=November+Launches&utm_medium=email_action&utm_source=customer.io ), the open spec for agent sign-up. Your agent registers with your email, you click a link and type a code, and it gets its own short-lived credentials for Fly.io and Sprites. If you don't have an account yet, that click makes one.
* Pay for things ( https://fly.io/changelog/agents-can-buy-fly-credits-with-mpp/?utm_campaign=November+Launches&utm_content=November+Launches&utm_medium=email_action&utm_source=customer.io ). When your org credit runs low, your agent can top it up ( https://fly.io/agents.md?utm_campaign=November+Launches&utm_content=November+Launches&utm_medium=email_action&utm_source=customer.io ) over HTTP 402 with Link. You approve it with a tap in the Link app. And with the Link connector ( https://fly.io/changelog/link-agent-wallet/?utm_campaign=November+Launches&utm_content=November+Launches&utm_medium=email_action&utm_source=customer.io ), an agent in a Sprite can buy what it needs outside of Fly.io (a domain, an API plan) on a single-use card, capped at the amount you approved.

Hacksgiving: Build Agent, Get Money.

We haven't run a hackathon for… an unacceptable period of time. Hacksgiving ( https://fly.io/hacksgi

Subiect: Free plan returns for Hacksgiving

Conținut:
Hi folks,

No time to mince words with a witty intro.

A lot of exciting stuff is going live this week, and it's Hacksgiving (which is our best attempt at naming our November hackathon). It will come as no surprise that the details… are below.

The Return of the Free Plan

Yes, we have a Free Plan ( https://fly.io/changelog/introducing-the-free-plan/?utm_campaign=November+Launches&utm_content=November+Launches&utm_medium=email_action&utm_source=customer.io ) again. You get $5 of usage every month, on the house. It's made for personal orgs, and you will need to add a card to sign up. The Free plan includes:

* Up to 3 Machines and 3 Sprites, so there's room for an app, a worker and somewhere for your agent to cook.
* Volumes up to 5 GB, to store things in.
* One member (you) and community support.

For the full details and the obligatory T's and C's look here ( https://fly.io/pricing/?utm_campaign=November+Launches&utm_content=November+Launches&utm_medium=email_action&utm_source=customer.io ).

MPG for Four Bucks

You wanted a cuter MPG plan and we delivered. Developer ( https://fly.io/changelog/highly-available-managed-postgres-for-4-a-month/?utm_campaign=November+Launches&utm_content=November+Launches&utm_medium=email_action&utm_source=customer.io ) is the smallest Managed Postgres plan we've ever made. You get a shared CPU, 256 MB of RAM and 1 GB of storage for a meager $4 a month. It doesn't get point-in-time restore or read replicas, so it's better for development and side projects than the project paying your rent.

Your Agent Has More Agency

Your agent can now do more boring things all by itself:

* Sign up for a Fly.io account. We now support auth.md ( https://fly.io/auth.md?utm_campaign=November+Launches&utm_content=November+Launches&utm_medium=email_action&utm_source=customer.io ), the open spec for agent sign-up. Your agent registers with your email, you click a link and type a code, and it gets its own short-lived credentials for Fly.io and Sprites. If you don't have an account yet, that click makes one.
* Pay for things ( https://fly.io/changelog/agents-can-buy-fly-credits-with-mpp/?utm_campaign=November+Launches&utm_content=November+Launches&utm_medium=email_action&utm_source=customer.io ). When your org credit runs low, your agent can top it up ( https://fly.io/agents.md?utm_campaign=November+Launches&utm_content=November+Launches&utm_medium=email_action&utm_source=customer.io ) over HTTP 402 with Link. You approve it with a tap in the Link app. And with the Link connector ( https://fly.io/changelog/link-agent-wallet/?utm_campaign=November+Launches&utm_content=November+Launches&utm_medium=email_action&utm_source=customer.io ), an agent in a Sprite can buy what it needs outside of Fly.io (a domain, an API plan) on a single-use card, capped at the amount you approved.

Hacksgiving: Build Agent, Get Money.

We haven't run a hackathon for… an unacceptable period of time. Hacksgiving ( https://fly.io/hacksgi
